claim: Patchline executes a public-repository corpus in parallel while guaranteeing deterministic output ordering and per-repository failure isolation, so a large corpus runs fast without sacrificing reproducibility. Each repository task runs concurrently with a distinct completion time, yet the collated results are always ordered by repository identity rather than by completion order, and a single failing repository is recorded as failed without aborting or corrupting the others. The gate proves the collated order is byte-identical across runs, that the deliberately failing repository is isolated as failed, and that every other repository still succeeds.
real_repo: patchline (self): corpus tasks scheduled concurrently and collated deterministically
